decisive_items: superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
response.rationale: R5 is the strongest candidate due to the presence of numerous eosinophils and inflammation in the biopsy findings, which is consistent with eosinophilic dermatitis. R3 is a close runner-up, but it is less specific than R5.

rejected.why: lacks specificity regarding the type of rash
too narrow, as it only considers pembrolizumab as the cause
too narrow, as it only considers ipilimumab as the cause
lacks evidence of eosinophils and inflammation
is an append-only completion of R3 and does not provide new information
